zh.Figure1: 图1　动物文库与原始标记表达。A、B：原规则选择的星形胶质及内皮细胞数，每点代表一个动物文库，短黑线为组均值；发现队列Sham/MCAO各3只，验证队列3/2只。C、D：每动物先计算原始计数>0的标记检出比例，再在动物间等权平均。白线将目标谱系标记与髓系标记分开。这里展示校正前的身份审计；去污染敏感性另见图4。
zh.Figure2: 图2　相同候选分母下的表达与原生优先级效应及标签零基线。A、B：原规则187条全动物完整候选的MCAO−Sham均值效应，每点为一个有向候选；蓝色表示两队列非零同向，橙色为其他。C：原规则及参考支持选择下，五个指标在各自固定187/174条候选中的同向比例；参照线段为200种联合动物标签配置的2.5%–97.5%分位范围，另示零分布中位数，均不是效应置信区间。D：原规则10%资格门槛在每次配置中重算，观测258/323（79.9%）对应联合零分布中位50.0%、单项精确P=0.005及6项探索家族Holm校正P=0.030。固定集合家族的校正结果在正文及全表另列。每队列内置换完整动物向量，候选间共享组分保持；外部队列条件置换仍只有10种配置。
zh.Figure3: 图3　实现诊断和排名候选母集的影响。左列为原规则选择，右列为参考支持singlet选择；全部面板保持相同187/174条目标候选。Native v1.10.0为原生LIANA共识；Unique-column RRA在相同完整网络中仅对每个独特幅度分数列排序一次；+ fixed global set进一步固定所有11个文库共有的7,675/7,109条完整全网络边。A、B为疾病均值效应的跨队列Spearman相关。C、D实心点以全部固定候选为分母，空心点以两队列效应均非零者为分母。E、F显示非零与至少一队列零效应的条目数，它们不是表达缺失。效应绝对值≤10⁻¹²视为数值零。此为描述性干预，无新增P值；RRA分数不是简单百分位名次。 独特分数列诊断在22份原始网络上逐值吻合已知上游修正[LIANA PR #261](https://github.com/scverse/liana/pull/261)的独立聚合函数，不代表完整新版流程重跑。
zh.FigureS1: 补充图S1　独立参考身份与细胞保留。A–D：各位置为一个动物文库，圆点为全脑标签一致率，菱形为皮层/海马一致率，空心方块为全脑一致、最高sigmoid得分≥0.5且Scrublet未标记的保留率，分母为原规则目标细胞。E、F：先计算每动物原标签行内的全脑参考标签比例，再等权平均，格内为四舍五入百分数。最佳匹配参考没有未分配输出；参考一致率不是测得的身份准确率。
zh.FigureS2: 补充图S2　各文库Scrublet观测与模拟分数。统一分箱，纵轴为相应观测或模拟总数归一化后的箱内比例；蓝色实线为观测细胞，橙色虚线为模拟双细胞，黑色点划线为自动阈值。GSM7841720的阈值高于全部观测分数，故标记数为零；未手动调阈值。这是技术质控，无细胞层面的疾病推断。
zh.FigureS3: 补充图S3　屏障相关单基因的细胞选择敏感性。各格为相应原队列和选择中的内皮细胞动物级PyDESeq2 MCAO相对Sham log2倍数变化。空心圆为相应内皮转录组BH校正P<0.05；色阶截于±3，完整值存档。白线分隔连接、转运、激活及血管生成面板。同队列四列复用相同动物，属于选择敏感性；此图使用原始UMI pseudobulk，未将连续DecontX估计送入DESeq2。
zh.FigureS4: 补充图S4　分选样本的配对效应与区间。A为星形胶质组分，B为内皮组分；彩色点为六个独立样本池各自的缺血侧减对侧log2(作者标准化值+1)差，黑点及线为均值和点式95% t置信区间（自由度5）。每池含3–4只鼠，对侧并非Sham。11个组分来自既定示例，未按本图显著性重新选择；所有49,914项描述结果及此前全部P值另存，不以区间作同时显著性判断。
zh.FigureS5: 补充图S5　候选组分空间表达背景。每点为质控合格Visium空间点，上行为Control切片（2,416点），下行为Day 1切片（2,498点），A–D为Spp1、Itga5、Ptn、Ptprz1。坐标来自原始alignment JSON与已核验条码映射；同一基因上下图使用相同色阶，上限为两图合并表达的第99百分位。没有组织学区域标签，未指定核心或半暗带；空间点混合多类细胞。本图仅提供表达背景，5个切片记录的全部描述表保留存档。

en.Figure1: Figure 1. Animal libraries and uncorrected marker expression. A,B: Primary-rule astrocyte and endothelial counts; each point is one animal library and the short black line is the group mean. Discovery has 3 Sham/3 MCAO animals and validation has 3/2. C,D: Raw-count detection (>0) is calculated within each animal and averaged with equal animal weights. White separators distinguish target-lineage and myeloid markers. These are pre-correction identity audits; ambient sensitivity is shown in Figure 4.
en.Figure2: Figure 2. Expression and native-priority effects on matched candidates and animal-label null references. A,B: MCAO-minus-Sham mean effects for the same 187 all-animal-complete primary-rule directed candidates; blue indicates nonzero concordant effects and orange denotes other outcomes. C: Observed all-candidate concordance for five metrics under primary and reference-supported selection, using 187/174 candidates. Reference segments denote the 2.5th–97.5th percentiles across 200 joint label allocations, with null medians also shown; these are not effect confidence intervals. D: The original 10% group gate is recomputed in each allocation. Observed 258/323 concordance (79.9%) is compared with a 50.0% null median; exact P=0.005 and Holm-adjusted P=0.030 refer to exploratory family C (six tests). Adjusted fixed-set results are reported separately. Whole-animal score vectors preserve shared ligand/receptor dependence. The conditional validation diagnostic still has only ten label allocations.
en.Figure3: Figure 3. Aggregation implementation and ranking-universe sensitivity. Columns represent primary and reference-supported singlet selection, retaining the same 187/174 target candidates throughout. Native v1.10.0 is the installed LIANA consensus. Unique-column RRA ranks each distinct magnitude-score column once on the unchanged full network. The fixed-global variant additionally restricts ranking to the 7,675/7,109 complete full-network edges shared by all 11 libraries. A,B: Spearman correlation of disease mean effects. C,D: Filled points use all fixed candidates; open points use candidates with nonzero effects in both cohorts. E,F: Counts of nonzero and at-least-one-zero disease effects, which do not indicate missing expression. Absolute effects ≤10⁻¹² are treated as numerical zero. This descriptive intervention adds no P values; the bounded RRA score differs from a simple percentile rank. The unique-column diagnostic exactly matched the isolated aggregation function of the known upstream correction in [LIANA PR #261](https://github.com/scverse/liana/pull/261) on the 22 raw networks; this is not a complete newer-release rerun.
en.FigureS1: Supplementary Figure S1. Reference identity and cell retention. A–D: Each position represents an animal library. Circles show whole-brain label agreement, diamonds cortical/hippocampal agreement, and open squares retention after whole-brain agreement, maximum sigmoid score ≥0.5 and exclusion of Scrublet flags. Denominators are primary-rule target cells. E,F: Whole-brain reference proportions are computed within each animal's original label and then equally averaged; annotations are rounded percentages. Best-match reference prediction has no unassigned output. Agreement is not measured identity accuracy.
en.FigureS2: Supplementary Figure S2. Scrublet observed and simulated score distributions by library. Common bins show fractions normalized to the respective observed or simulated total. Blue solid lines denote observed cells, orange dashed lines simulated doublets, and black dash-dotted lines saved automatic thresholds. The GSM7841720 threshold exceeds all observed scores and flags no cells; thresholds were not manually tuned. This is technical QC without cell-level disease inference.
en.FigureS3: Supplementary Figure S3. Selection sensitivity of barrier-related gene effects. Cells show animal-level endothelial PyDESeq2 log2 fold changes for MCAO versus Sham in each original cohort and selection. Open circles denote BH-adjusted P<0.05 within the corresponding endothelial transcriptome. Color is capped at ±3; complete values are archived. White lines separate junction, transport, activation and angiogenesis panels. Four selections reuse the same animals. These are original integer-UMI pseudobulk analyses; fractional DecontX estimates were not supplied to DESeq2.
en.FigureS4: Supplementary Figure S4. Paired sorted-sample effects and intervals. A: Astrocyte components; B: endothelial components. Colored points show each of six independent pools' ipsilateral-minus-contralateral log2(author-normalized value+1) difference. Black points and segments show means and pointwise 95% t intervals (5 degrees of freedom). Pools contain 3–4 mice, and the contralateral hemisphere is not Sham. The eleven components were retained from existing examples rather than selected by this display. All 49,914 descriptive results and historical P values are archived; intervals do not provide simultaneous significance classification.
en.FigureS5: Supplementary Figure S5. Spatial expression context. Each point is a QC-passing Visium spot in the Control (top; 2,416 spots) or Day 1 section (bottom; 2,498 spots). A–D show Spp1, Itga5, Ptn and Ptprz1. Coordinates derive from original alignment JSON and verified barcode mapping. Each gene shares one scale across both sections, capped at the pooled 99th percentile. Histological region labels were unavailable; core and penumbra labels were not assigned. Spots mix multiple cell types. This supplementary display supplies expression context; complete descriptive tables for all five section records remain archived.
